assumptions.guardrails: No breach is assumed for decision simulation, not observed safety.
assumptions.net: Frozen 100k cohort G*gamma-K; pilot coefficient maps observed outcomes to gamma. Economic transfer is assumed.
assumptions.p0: Uniform(0.027711484302, 0.067711484302) generative and inference prior; half-width 2 percentage points [A]
assumptions.prevention: Beta priors and uniform independent prevention are unverified [A]

method.cross_checks: Required direct formula and centered-gain identity retained with MCSE. Grid refined on first 64 pilots; full refinement if >$5.
method.large_n_tolerance: Posterior-regret mean + 1.96 MCSE + grid discrepancy <= max($5, 5% EVPI).
method.posterior: Midpoint quadrature on full support with exact Beta density and flat bounded p0 density; log stabilized binomial likelihood.
method.primary_evsi: EVPI - E[posterior decision regret], mathematically equivalent to required preposterior formula; no clipping.
method.wrong_call: Wrong decisive scale/stop only; extend is not a wrong call; gamma .14-.18 excluded.
